notes: The LED on pin 13 is the board's built-in LED, so no external LED is added.
The potentiometer straddles the breadboard centre gap: its wiper leg is in the upper half (column 11) and its two outer legs are in the lower half (columns 10 and 12).

Row letters follow the catalogue convention (top bank a-e, bottom bank f-j). The image labels the halves the other way round, so the exact row letters are approximate. The column strips are what matter.
The black wire goes to the second GND pin in the power header. I mapped it to GND.1, and GND.1 and GND.2 are the same net.
The potentiometer outer legs are interchangeable. I mapped column 10 to GND and column 12 to VCC, following the black and red wires.
